\subsection*{You'll want to know: profond / profonde}
\textbf{profond / profonde} — \textquotedblleft{}deep\textquotedblright{}.

\end{cousinweb}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 152-155 — a first pass}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To admire? (\textbf{admirer}.) To act? (\textbf{agir}.) To move forward? (\textbf{avancer}.) To move back? (\textbf{reculer}.) To lower? (\textbf{baisser}.) To notice? (\textbf{remarquer}.) To replace? (\textbf{remplacer}.) To meet? (\textbf{rencontrer}.) To blush? (\textbf{rougir}.) To bleed? (\textbf{saigner}.) Health? (\textbf{la santé}.) The brain? (\textbf{le cerveau}.) A lung? (\textbf{le poumon}.) The liver? (\textbf{le foie}.) A kidney? (\textbf{le rein}.) Rest? (\textbf{le repos}.) Sleep? (\textbf{le sommeil}.) A dream? (\textbf{le rêve}.) Anxiety? \section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 156-160 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R160-second-pass-words-from-chapters-156-160}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rarely, afterwards, finally, from now on, still
  \item above, below, in front, behind, beside
  \item so, however, anyway, on the contrary, although
  \item comfortable, uncomfortable, polite, rude, unpleasant
  \item deep, low, unknown, dangerous, safe
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rarely? (\textbf{rarement}.) Afterwards? (\textbf{ensuite}.) Finally? (\textbf{enfin}.) From now on? (\textbf{désormais}.) Still? (\textbf{encore}.) Above? (\textbf{au-dessus}.) Below? (\textbf{au-dessous}.) In front? (\textbf{devant}.) Behind? (\textbf{derrière}.) Beside? (\textbf{à côté}.) So? (\textbf{donc}.) However? (\textbf{pourtant}.) Anyway? (\textbf{de toute façon}.) On the contrary? (\textbf{au contraire}.) Although? (\textbf{bien que}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{confortable}.) Uncomfortable? (\textbf{inconfortable}.) Polite? (\textbf{poli / polie}.) Rude? (\textbf{impoli / impolie}.) Unpleasant? (\textbf{désagréable}.) Deep? (\textbf{profond / profonde}.) Low? (\textbf{bas / basse}.) Unknown? (\textbf{inconnu / inconnue}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{dangereux / dangereuse}.) Safe? (\textbf{sûr / sûre}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
